messages:
Alex: FYI the gitops pipeline flagged a plan error when upgrading gpu-pools module from v2 to v3 in staging. plan fails with missing KMS role.

infra-bot: [automation] terraform plan in repo infra/terraform/staging returned non-zero exit (code 1). link: https://ci.internal/exp/1234

Maria: dump of error? can you paste the tf log?

Alex: paste block:
```
Error: Missing required argument "kms_key_id" for resource "aws_ebs_volume" "gpu_cache"
  on modules/gpu-pool/main.tf line 42, in resource "aws_ebs_volume" "gpu_cache":
 42: resource "aws_ebs_volume" "gpu_cache" {
```

Sam: looks like v3 changed the KMS input to be kms_key_arn vs kms_key_id, breaking backwards compat.

Jen: Wasn't there a migration note? I thought we had a compatibility wrapper in module v2.

Alex: v3 removed the wrapper. Our consumers expect kms_key_id. So this is env drift combined with module-major bump.

Maria: short term: pin staging to module ref v2.4.1 and add an acceptance test in pipeline. long term: add semver channeling (stable/next) and module-adapter for kms.

Sam: PR idea:
```
- update modules/gpu-pool ref -> v2.4.1
- add tfci test: apply -> smoke -> destroy
- add module changelog check in gitops CI
```

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-789: "gpu-pool module major bump broke staging plan" and linked to CI run.

Jen: I'll open the PR to pin (branch fix/module-pin-gpu-staging). tagging @maria @sam for review.

Maria: also schedule canary in us-west-2 only, don't promote to eu regions until tests pass.

Sam: I'll add the acceptance test to terraform-ci repo and add KMS compatibility check.

Alex: thanks. followups: 1) PR by Jen, 2) CI tests by Sam, 3) canary run after merge by Maria. keep thread updated :thumbsup:
